summary: Destroyed vehicles burn out end to end (black char, heat-greyed paint, rust, soot, ash, tyres and canvas gone, blackened ground, debris), a tank whose ammunition goes up loses its turret, and shot-down helicopters lie crashed and broken.
rationale: Original wreck follow-up stills, reused without recapture on the integration tree. The burnt-out sheet compares the same stage, seed and elapsed time; the tank after-view is reframed to include the hull and detached turret, so its camera is not matched. The helicopter sheet shows crash poses and broken rotors. These stills show appearance and settled poses, not turret-launch or crash motion. The original capture.json retains the capture circumstances.
